title: From Planning to Resupply: US Army Expands AI Logistics With $99M Deal | Rune Technologies News
summary: Rune Technologies secured a $99 million five-year contract to deploy its TyrOS artificial intelligence platform for modernizing military supply chain operations and decision support across U.S. Army units.
body_markdown:
The Defense Post covered Rune Technologies by Samantha Alexa in a piece titled “From Planning to Resupply: US Army Expands AI Logistics With $99M Deal.” Rune Technologies secured a $99 million five-year contract to deploy its TyrOS artificial intelligence platform for modernizing military supply chain operations and decision support across U.S. Army units.


Read the full article[here](https://thedefensepost.com/2026/06/26/us-army-ai-logistics-rune-tyros/) .
